test_bert_tokenizer: test the BertTokenizer class to tokenize text into BERT input IDs, segment IDs, and attention masks
test_vilt_tokenizer: test the VILTTextTokenizer class to tokenize text for VILT vision-language model input
test_uniter_tokenizer: test the UNITERTextTokenizer class to produce both original and masked input IDs for UNITER training
test_vinvl_tokenizer: test the VinVLTextTokenizer class to tokenize text with masking and corruption for VinVL model input
test_tokenizer_masking: test BERT tokenizer masking behavior by setting mask probability to 1.0 and verifying MASK tokens appear
